Who we are

Founded by Andreas Hadjigeorgiou, avocadots is not your typical agency.

We're a team of designers, strategists and marketers who believe great work comes from fresh ideas, clear systems and genuine collaboration. We mix creativity with strategy, art with data, and fun with performance.

Our offices reflect who we are: open, vibrant, and always buzzing with ideas.

We believe in transparency, teamwork, and results that speak for themselves. No complicated language, no hidden processes — just clear communication, measurable outcomes, and a team that genuinely cares about helping your business grow.

Always transparent. Always fresh. Always ready to help you grow. If you'd rather hear it from the businesses we've worked with, read our client reviews.

Our story

It started in 2020 — three people, one small office, and one big idea.

We wanted to build a studio that challenges the ordinary. One where design, web and marketing work together as one system.

Since then avocadots has become a full-scale creative and digital studio, helping brands across Cyprus and Europe grow through bold ideas, sharp design and measurable strategy.

We're still as curious and hands-on as day one. The only difference? Now we've got the data, the team and the track record to back it up.

2020

Three people, one small office in Nicosia, and one refusal: design, web and marketing should not live in separate vendors.

Then

Wix Studio and Shopify became a core offer rather than a side job.

Since

The team grew across design, project management, branding and paid media.

Today

Nine people, 150+ companies helped, and brands across Cyprus and Europe.
